description: Stacked horizontal bars of patient-actor ratings (% of consultations across five favorability levels plus cannot rate) for AMIE versus PCP, across GMCPQ, MXEKF and PACES items.
not_read: Segment lengths are estimated from bar edges, with no printed values. Error is about ±1 percentage point. Thin hatched slivers (Unfavorable, Very unfavorable) are less certain, at about 0.3–1 point.
Significance stars (*** / **) and N per item are given only in the chart notes and not as data points. They are about 25 short labels.
